title: Govern adapters and transformations that may alter meaning
requirements:
- Allow systems internal models provided boundaries are conformant and meaning-preserving
- Add to 3.7 testing that clinically significant meaning survives translation from logical model to technical artefact and end-to-end exchange
- Replace the fixed 'consumer provides the adapter' rule with explicit assignment of adapter ownership
- Name what must be preserved: provenance, status/certainty/negation, terminology bindings, units, concept relationships
- Require transformation specifications documenting loss and assumptions, with mapping testing
- Cover the selected terminology/classification pathway (e.g. ICD-11) and terminology-service operations in test cases
- Soften 'semantic alignment at the source' to 'as close to the source as practicable'
- Note existing frameworks (e.g. FHIR terminology service conformance) that can be reused
